title: Suddenly can't log in to Microsoft/Office365 email server with TB
creator: BlebNevus1015
content:
I'm still able to access my email, which is hosted by Microsoft, using their online Outlook portal. But as of yesterday I'm getting this error message when I try to connect from TB: "The STAT command did not succeed. Error getting message number and sizes. Mail server outlook.office365.com responded: Server Unavailable." A MS tech says the server *is* available and that the problem is that they've phased out IMAP and POP (my account is set up as the latter) and all local clients must now be configured as Exchange Online.

Does this sound like a plausible explanation for why I suddenly can't connect? FWIW, the link he sent me doesn't say IMAP and POP are deprecated. It dealt only with authentication. (Last year Microsoft started requiring OAuth2 instead of Basic Authentication and I changed my server settings accordingly.)

If he's right, what are my options? Is it possible to switch server type on TB to Exchange Online? How? And if I did so, what would happen in terms of archiving my messages after they're downloaded and being able to specify how long they're kept on the server?

FWIW, I tried deleting my password, restarting, and reentering PW when asked as well as trying other security settings. Also, I have TB on two computers (both running Windows 10), and the same problem now shows up on both. One of them was just updated to v. 102.12.0, while the other still has the previous version.

Thanks for any help you may be able to offer.

EDITED TO ADD: A second MS tech contradicted the first one and said IMAP and POP protocols are still fine to use. That's a relief, but it also leaves me wondering whether there's anything I should do other than wait and hope the problem is on the server side and will eventually be resolved.

title: Upgrade to TG 102 prevents contacts from syncing
creator: receiver
content:
I have been using the TBsync add-on for quite some time without any problems but when I finally allowed TB to upgrade to Ver 102 that came to an end.

After doing some fiddling around (i.e., disable/enable syncing) the calendar appears to have resumed syncing properly.

I have done a bit of research but I'm afraid this turns out to be a fairly complex issue. For example, this article, seems to imply that TBsync is no longer needed to sync contacts but also suggests that it has converted to using built-in TB CardDAV capability which implies that it should continue to work.

Also, TBsync includes syncing of Categories which can serve is an alternative to eMail (Distribution) Lists which apparently are never synced.

At this point it would be helpful if I could find some documentation that elaborates a bit on how syncing without TBsync would work. This should especially include what servers it is known to work with.
